imageNote: This lesson teaches a general due-diligence skill (docs, GitHub, verified contract, audits) rather than one product's specific screen, and a block explorer's live Read/Write Contract UI changes per contract and per network, so a single screenshot would mislead more than it would teach. Checked Uniswap's and Aave's current docs sites and Etherscan's own docs directly for any representative diagram; none fit a general, protocol-agnostic lesson. The visual content is an original worked example of real function signatures (getReserves, balanceOf, swap, mint) as code slides, not a claimed screenshot.
